venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: Warm, lower 80s; cool air toward evening
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Friday 10/2 (MOD MKZ//JK; warm lower 80s).** Net sales $8,143 vs target $7,041 (+15.7%). Food $706. Comps N/A. 261 guests, check avg $31.20. Bachelorette and pre-wedding parties came in; most business arrived at 9 and stayed steady until ~1. Bar team handled the rush gracefully with cocktail recommendations. DJ had the crowd dancing and singing along. Kitchen/maintenance/86s: N/A. No incidents. Entered by Daniel.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Friday 10/2 (MOD KE, JMS; rainy).** Net sales $8,198 vs target $10,762 (-23.8%). Food $190. Comps $152 / 1.85%. 288 guests, check avg $28. Slower night across the neighborhood (neighbors Oku and Charmers also slow). Decent pop around 12:30–1am added $800–$1,000. Regulars, returning guests and out-of-town visitors incl. Europe; October/Halloween programming talks promising. Kitchen smooth; JMS helped on the floor. (Report text says 'Saturday'; form date is Friday 10/2.) Entered by BT.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.weather: Nice, but First Friday pulled traffic to other areas of Denver, not RiNo
venues.narrative: **DVR — Friday 10/2 (AM Maggie S & Josh; PM Carey & Lucas).** Net sales incl. events $16,209.50 vs target $17,326 (-6.4%). DC/AM $944.36; D&C PM $15,265.14; Garden/6A $3,457.68; food $2,646.60. Comps $764.59 / 4.69%. 309 guests (Tock), check avg $52.46. Slow start, mid-shift pop, usual shifties at end; slower than desired Friday so wait list directed to the Garden. Kitchen steady (Lucas, Rand, Isa); Emma's Stage went very well. Fully staffed, great mood. Entered by Carey.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Friday 10/2 (MOD Kyler / Steves; humid).** Total EOD net sales incl. events $13,535 vs target $7,711 (+75.5%). Food $279, beverage $3,472, event sales $10,533 (wedding afterparty; room closed for event). Comps $109.40. 106 guests (SevenRooms), check avg $127. Strong first turn, slow traffic given event closure; room filled quickly during event, everyone left ~2:30. Top sellers: Rosalie, Paper Wasp, Eight Limb Daiquiri. Breakage 1x water glass. Submitted late (10/3 10:28am ET); form date typed '9/2'. Entered by Sean.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Friday 10/2 (MOD Gigi, Julian, Joe, Saleh, Josh; humid).** Net sales $12,456 vs target $11,549 (+7.9%). Marquee $9,304; Standing Room $3,152; food $2,537. Comps $436 (Ken, Ray, Enoch, Caitlyn, birthday, celebrations, DNL). 309 guests; check avg $40.31 (net/guests; form reported $93.66, which appears to be per-check). Sleepy first hours (98 covers early), room full ~7:30, standing room filled, waitlist and rush ~9pm; many large-party walk-ins. No-shows charged: Yes. Form date typed 10/3; matched by post time (10/3 05:53 ET). Entered by Joe.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Friday 10/2 (MOD Marcus / Josh; hot then rain).** Total net sales incl. events $8,453.89 vs target $8,396 (+0.7%). Marquee bar $7,478.90; Garden $1,150; food $937; reported total sales $8,628.90. Comps $175.01, voids $86. 204 guests, check avg $41.44 (form GCA $35.67 / CA $69.46). Slower start from heat then rain; peak ~7:45pm. Flag: sold 10 menu-insert items but zero Piña French 75s though ~6 went out — POS ringing accuracy. Improve ticket pacing, KDS clearing. Curtains need maintenance. Entered by Josh.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Friday 10/2 (AM Justin & Lex; PM Sam & James / Shannon & Marcus; rainy).** Net sales $10,550 vs target $11,507 (-8.3%). Municipal AM $1,497, PM $6,429; Sun Club $50; Hot Eye $2,548. Food reported as $0 (not broken out). Comps $286. 210 guests (56 AM + 154 PM OpenTable), check avg $50.24. Rain cancelled two of four food tours; evening rush never came. Hot Eye full by 9pm with large booth parties, positive feedback on new menu. Crisalli machine still down. Entered by Alexis.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Friday 10/2 (MOD Curtis Hayes; sunny, warm).** Net sales $12,241 vs target $11,596 (+5.6%). Food $1,594. Comps $560.30 / 4.4% (shifties, recovery table, employee 50% tab). 279 guests, check avg $44.51. Slower start, solid push 7–8pm, wait list worked through with one 5-top pressure point recovered with comped drinks. Ticket pacing wonky; bottles wearing on wood counter; pinch point on floor. Andrew's first closing night in kitchen (~$1.6k food). Entered by Curtis Hayes.
